title: Beyond Time Induction: Structured Conditional Neural Solvers for Parametric Stochastic-Volatility Pricing
abstract: arXiv:2610.19254v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks provide a flexible framework for learning parametric PDE solution families without labeled data, yet preserving accurate derivatives across heterogeneous regimes remains challenging. Structured neural solvers offer compact representations, but restrictive conditional parameterizations can limit adaptation across the solution family. We introduce BeTINN, a structured conditional architecture extending time-induced modulation through multi-directional time-parameter conditioning and a joint residual pathway. We evaluate BeTINN on the Heston stochastic-volatility PDE, a demanding parametric problem with mixed derivatives and economically relevant first- and second-order sensitivities. BeTINN improves joint accuracy across normalized option value and key sensitivity metrics relative to our baselines. Controlled ablations characterize the roles of its architectural components. translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络为在无需标注数据的情况下学习参数化偏微分方程解族提供了一个灵活框架，然而在异构机制之间保持精确的导数仍然具有挑战性。结构化神经求解器提供了紧凑的表示形式，但受限的条件参数化可能限制其在整个解族上的适应能力。我们提出了BeTINN，这是一种结构化条件架构，通过多方向的时间-参数条件化和联合残差通路扩展了时间诱导调制机制。我们在Heston随机波动率偏微分方程上评估了BeTINN，这是一个具有挑战性的参数化问题，涉及混合导数以及具有经济意义的一阶和二阶敏感度。相对于我们的基线方法，BeTINN在归一化期权价值和关键敏感度指标上提升了联合精度。受控消融实验刻画了其各个架构组件的作用。我们进一步发现验证p……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出BeTINN结构化条件神经求解器，通过多方向时间-参数条件化和联合残差通路扩展时间诱导调制，在Heston随机波动率定价中显著提升期权价值与关键敏感度的联合预测精度。
en_tdlr: We introduce BeTINN, a structured conditional neural solver extending time-induced modulation via multi-directional time-parameter conditioning and a joint residual pathway, which improves joint accuracy of option values and economically relevant sensitivities for the Heston stochastic-volatility PDE.
